trap.label: misto / tempos
trap.wrong: If we would have signed, we would be leading now.
trap.right: If we had signed, we would be leading now.
trap.why: Em português o subjuntivo “se tivéssemos assinado” não tem tradução óbvia, e o brasileiro usa would na oração com if. Em inglês, if + past perfect.

mcq.q: If we ___ signed, we would be leading now.

mcq.why: If = se; unless = a menos que.

opts: If it will rain, we stay.
If it would rain, we stay.

fix.wrong: If I would know, I would tell you.
fix.right: If I knew, I would tell you.

fix.wrong: Unless you don’t sign, we lose.
If we would have won, we would celebrate.
fix.right: If we had won, we would celebrate.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva em 3º condicional: “She didn’t rehearse, so the pitch didn’t land.” (If…)
rewrite.answer: If she had rehearsed, the pitch would have landed.

rewrite.prompt: Use unless: “If you don’t sign, we stay.”
Misto: “I didn’t sign, so I’m not leading now.” (If…)
rewrite.answer: If I had signed, I would be leading now.
